gaps.sentence: We had the whole house ___ (repaint) before the wedding.
gaps.explanation: 'Had the house repainted' — painters did it at our request. Object + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The painting is believed ___ (steal) by an organised gang.
gaps.explanation: The theft preceded the believing: is believed to have been + stolen.

gaps.sentence: The finalists ___ (interview) live on air as we speak.
gaps.explanation: 'As we speak' demands the present continuous passive: are being + interviewed.

gaps.sentence: Parcels ___ (leave) in the porch if nobody is home.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: should be + left. A recommendation; 'are left' (routine) is also acceptable.

gaps.sentence: Your booking ___ (confirm) by email — check your spam folder.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: has been + confirmed; the confirmation exists now.

gaps.sentence: They're getting the garden ___ (landscape) this spring.
gaps.explanation: Causative with get: are getting + the garden + landscaped.

gaps.sentence: He's getting his eyes ___ next week.
gaps.explanation: Causative get + object + past participle: getting his eyes tested (by an optician).

gaps.sentence: Your luggage ___ (weigh) at check-in, so allow extra time.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + weighed. The agent (staff) is obvious.
